name: Uzziah/Azariah (son of Amaziah)
title: The Leper King
summary: Uzziah, also called Azariah, was king of Judah for 52 years and one of the longest-reigning kings. He was a powerful and successful king who strengthened Judah militarily and economically, but his pride led to him being struck with leprosy when he attempted to burn incense in the temple, an task reserved for the priests.

keyEvents.title: Becomes King at Age 16
keyEvents.description: Uzziah became king of Judah when he was sixteen years old, after his father Amaziah was killed in a conspiracy.

keyEvents.title: Does What Is Right in the Lord's Eyes
keyEvents.description: Uzziah sought God under the guidance of the prophet Zechariah, and as long as he sought the Lord, God gave him success.

keyEvents.title: Military Success and Expansion
keyEvents.description: He waged war against the Philistines and Arabs, built towers in Jerusalem and in the wilderness, and had a well-equipped army of 307,500 men.

keyEvents.title: Developed Agriculture and Water Supply
keyEvents.description: Uzziah loved farming and owned many herds, vineyard workers, and farmers, and he dug many wells.

keyEvents.title: Pride and Sin in the Temple
keyEvents.description: When Uzziah became powerful, his heart grew proud. He entered the temple to burn incense on the altar of incense, which only priests were allowed to do.

keyEvents.title: Struck with Leprosy
keyEvents.description: The Lord struck Uzziah with leprosy because of his pride, and he had to live in a separate house for the rest of his life while his son Jotham ruled the land.
